messages:
maya: Quick q — should the Console enforce operator-bindings for runtime config applies? thinking: UI shows diff, require approver, and produce audit / dry-run. :thinking:

jesse: +1 audit + schema validation. we shouldn't allow freeform key edits for scoped flags. maybe require 'apply_with_operator' role.

liam: we can reuse snapshot/diff infra. perf note: large configs can time out, so streaming diff view would help. example API call:
```
POST /api/v1/configs/apply
{ "snapshot_id": "s-abc123", "dry_run": true }
```

anika: telemetry: sample 1% by default for rollouts but capture full diff for failures. watch out for sampling bias on cohorts.

ops: need runbook + automatic rollback trigger on error-rate > 3% for 5m. also rate-limit console applies at 1/min per team.

maya: UI mock: show who can approve, a small inline diff, toggle canary cohorts, ttl for temporary overrides. :eyes:

jesse: also store git commit id + operator id in audit. idempotency: apply should be idempotent and return apply_id.

liam: suggestion: Add 'preview-replay' job that replays sampled traffic against preview config and surface metric deltas (latency, error-rate).

ops: strong - but replay infra costs. maybe make it opt-in per-team. +1 for dry-run mode though.

anika: metrics we'd track: apply_latency, preview_delta_p95, rollout_failure_count, override_ttl_expirations. tie to alerts.

maya: action items: 1) sketch console UX + permission model 2) API contract + example 3) telemetry spec 4) runbook template. volunteers?

jesse: I'll pick API contract + idempotency.

liam: UX sketch and preview replay prototype.

ops: runbook + rate limit gating.

anika: telemetry spec and alert rules, will write a first draft.

product-bot: Created ticket RW-2789 (operator-binding-console); linking spec docs: https://go/repo/RW-2789 :thumbsup:

maya: sweet — syncing 1pm today. ping me if blockers.
